relevant_laws.notes: Street direction, official notice erection and extent, the statutory left side, and stopping purpose require reviewed originals. No legal side or time cutoff is inferred.
relevant_laws.quote: When official traffic-control devices are erected giving notice thereof, a person shall not stand or park a vehicle upon the left-hand side of a one-way street.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: source-reviewed motor vehicle standing or parking beside a one-way street
